## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D-style life simulation for phones and tablets, with three families at different wealth levels and customizable daily life and travel.

## Requirements
- Three playable households: ultra-wealthy, rich, and average/no connections.
- Preselected family homes, clothes, money, jobs, businesses, vehicles, aircraft, insurance, and other assets.
- Vacation destinations: Singapore, Tokyo, Los Angeles, Doha, Dubai, London, Paris, Milan, New York, and Zurich; economy, business, and first-class travel.
- Responsive, playable phone/tablet game; no clarifying questions.

## Decisions
- Built a self-contained browser game with hand-drawn isometric-style canvas scenes and responsive HTML/CSS UI.
- Added household switching, finances, upgrades, assets/insurance, daily progression, goals, travel booking, and localStorage persistence.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented game dashboard, family data, home/travel scene rendering, modals, gameplay actions, navigation, and event handlers in `game.js`.
- Added destinations, cabin classes, trip lengths, ticket pricing, and travel scenes.
- `node --check game.js` passed.
- Browser opened successfully using system Chromium after updating the Playwright browser configuration to use `/usr/bin/chromium`.
- Confirmed the main page renders and household switching to The Ashfords updates displayed family details.
- Confirmed the travel modal lists the 10 destinations, three cabin classes, trip length selector, and booking action.
- Captured `screenshots/desktop.png`.

### Active
- Validate actual travel booking and trip progression, gameplay upgrades, and family switching persistence.
- Validate mobile layout and inspect screenshots; resolve any issues found.

### Blocked
- Browser console reports one 404 for `http://localhost:3002/favicon.ico`; no other console errors were observed.

## Next Move
1. Exercise destination selection, booking, daily trip progression, and return home in the browser.
2. Test career/business and asset upgrades, family actions, and household persistence.
3. Resize/emulate a phone and tablet; inspect screenshots for responsive layout and usability.
4. Address the favicon 404 if appropriate, rerun checks, and summarize remaining issues.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: Game state, rendering, UI panels, actions, and persistence.
- `index.html`: Dashboard and modal markup.
- `style.css`: Base and responsive styling.
- `screenshots/desktop.png`: Captured desktop rendering.
- `/home/runner/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json`: Playwright configuration now points to system Chromium.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; project files are untracked in git.
- Preview server is running at `http://localhost:3002`.
- `game.js` currently passes syntax checking.
